That said, this case is thin: 'not finally sentenced' most naturally means 'sentenced but not final (appeal pending)', which qualifies rather than refutes the claim, and contemporaneous reports (The Local 2025-10-15, CoStar 2025-10-17) plus five independent September 2026 retrospectives (Reuters, Spiegel, Die Presse, ORF Tirol, Krone) all describe an unconditional two-year first-instance sentence by the Landesgericht Innsbruck in October 2025. FALSE is therefore the runner-up, not the leader.
